entries.t: Cyberattack disrupts global news distribution platform at France’s AFP
entries.sum: French international news agency Agence France-Presse was hit by a cyberattack Thursday, forcing it to take offline one of its main platforms for distributing news content to media organizations worldwide.

entries.t: British government takes services offline following ‘cyber incident’
entries.sum: The DWP said that online services had been taken offline as a precaution following a cyber-incident, regular pension and benefit payments have not been affected

entries.t: Chinese and North Korean state hackers add ARTEX AI framework to their arsenal
entries.sum: State-sponsored hacking groups tied to Beijing and Pyongyang have started running the ARTEX pentesting tool in attacks, Microsoft Threat Intelligence warned this week.
